field.label: Listen address
field.help: Address all listeners bind to. :: is IPv6 only on FreeBSD; 127.0.0.1 when only a local reverse proxy should reach Warpgate.

field.label: External host
field.help: Hostname users reach Warpgate on, used for URLs and cookies. Required behind a reverse proxy; empty uses the request host.

field.label: TLS certificate
field.help: Certificate from System: Trust used by all TLS listeners (HTTPS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, VNC, RDP). Default: the self-signed certificate Warpgate generated.

field.label: Log retention
field.help: How long session logs are kept in the database. Duration, e.g. 30m, 1day, 7days.

field.label: Audit log retention
field.help: Default: about 1 year. Duration, e.g. 30m, 1day, 7days.

field.label: Log format
field.help: Format of the service log (Services: Warpgate: Log File).

field.label: Debug logging
field.help: Verbose service log for troubleshooting.

field.label: Forward logs to socket
field.help: Also send structured log events to this UNIX datagram socket.

field.label: Database URL
field.help: Default: sqlite:/var/db/warpgate/db. Use Tools: Copy database before switching to PostgreSQL or MySQL.

field.label: Admin API token
field.help: Enables an API token (header X-Warpgate-Token) that acts as the first admin user. Empty disables it.

field.label: Port
field.help: Web UI and HTTP targets. Must not collide with the OPNsense web GUI port.

field.label: External port
field.help: Port users connect to on a reverse proxy (usually 443), used to build URLs.

field.label: Behind a reverse proxy
field.help: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers for client address, scheme and host. Enable only if Warpgate is reachable exclusively through the proxy.

field.label: External host
field.help: Hostname clients use for this listener, if different from the global external host.

field.label: PROXY protocol
field.help: Accept HAProxy PROXY protocol v1/v2 headers (only when every connection comes from such a proxy).

field.label: Session lifetime
field.help: Idle web session lifetime. Duration, e.g. 30m, 1day, 7days.

field.label: Cookie lifetime
field.help: Duration, e.g. 30m, 1day, 7days.

field.label: Certificate
field.help: Certificate from System: Trust. Default: the general TLS certificate.

field.label: SNI certificates
field.help: Additional certificates picked by hostname (SNI), e.g. for HTTP targets on their own domains.

field.label: Port
field.help: Must not collide with the OPNsense SSH port.

field.label: Target host key verification
field.help: What to do with unknown target host keys. Only applied when the database is first created; later change it in the admin UI.

field.label: Inactivity timeout
field.help: Duration, e.g. 30m, 1day, 7days.

field.label: Keepalive interval
field.help: Empty disables keepalives. Duration, e.g. 30m, 1day, 7days.

field.label: Target handshake timeout
field.help: Duration, e.g. 30m, 1day, 7days.
